title: Dialectical Tree Schema
description: Structured data contract for dialectical mapping output — thesis-objection-response trees in philosophical argument analysis

analysis_id.description: Unique identifier for this dialectical analysis

source_text.description: Reference to the source text or argument being analyzed

root_node.description: The root thesis node of the dialectical tree

path.description: Node path to the bedrock disagreement

nature.description: What kind of fundamental disagreement (premise, method, standard)

dialectical_node.description: A node in the dialectical tree

id.description: Unique node identifier (e.g., T1, O1a, R1a1)

type.description: The dialectical role of this node

content.description: The claim or argument made at this node

objection_type.description: Type of objection (required if type is 'objection')

state.description: Dialectical state after all children have been processed

severity.description: Severity of the objection or strength of the response

source.description: Which philosopher or position this objection/response is associated with

children.description: Child nodes — objections to this claim, or responses to those objections
